subject.title: feat(gateway): land remaining durable-approvals stack and repair main gates

question: Should maintainers rebuild a narrow current-main integration for only the missing approval work, or accept ownership of repairing this 499-file reconciliation branch?
rationale: The current branch crosses security authorization, persisted state, native apps, release automation, plugins, UI, and unrelated current-main reversions; choosing the permanent landing vehicle and coordinating its owners requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Rebuild narrowly on current main
options.body: Carry only the missing approval propagation and fail-closed deltas while preserving all current-main storage, native, workflow, UI, and plugin behavior.

options.title: Repair the reconciliation branch
options.body: Coordinate every affected subsystem owner to fix all blockers, review the remaining reversions, and re-prove the exact integrated head.

options.title: Pause the remaining stack
options.body: Keep the already merged approval subsets and defer the remainder until a smaller safe landing vehicle exists.

recommendation.title: Rebuild narrowly on current main
recommendation.body: Carry only the missing approval propagation and fail-closed deltas while preserving all current-main storage, native, workflow, UI, and plugin behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The approval feature and integration history is concentrated in this owner’s merged commits, and this PR carries the protected `maintainer` label.
